196344.overview: Rally, released by Taito do Brasil in late 1980 or early 1981, is a digital solid-state machine widely regarded as a Brazilian classic. It is a reimagining of Bally's 1980 hit Skateball, featuring modified gameplay mechanics and original Brazilian-produced hardware and software.

448363.overview:
Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi is one of the three tables released for the Star Wars Pinball: Balance of the Force DLC pack, originally released for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX2 and later ported to Pinball FX3. The table adapts the conclusion to the original Star Wars trilogy, as the Rebel Alliance escapes the clutches of Jabba, and Luke & Vader are forced to come to terms against a greater evil.

Set in the forest of the Endor moon, players join Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Chewbacca, Princess Leia, Lando Calrissian, R2-D2, and C-3PO to defeat the Sith and restore peace in the galaxy!

The table is packed with interactive 3D objects inspired by the film including an AT-ST, Speeder bike, Death Star II hologram, TIE fighters, Tydirium shuttle and a Shield generator!

462457.overview:
Roman Victory is a rare pinball machine manufactured by Taito do Brasil in 1978. It is a notable example of the "cloning" era of Brazilian pinball, where local manufacturers created their own versions of international designs due to strict import restrictions. 

The playfield layout is a direct copy of the Fair Fight pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Recel in 1976. The machine features an ancient Roman aesthetic, with artwork focused on Julius Caesar.

468578.overview: Rome is a pinball table that was first released on Pinball FX 2, and is also available for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX 3 as one of the four Zen original tables that are part of the Core Collection. It is themed after the ancient Roman Empire, its culture and its conquest of Europe.

469422.overview:
Curtain up! Dance numbers, stage lights, and theatrical drama steal the spotlight in this musical pinball extravaganza.

Released in 1975, Red Show is an electro-mechanical pinball table from the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria. It is known for its vibrant aesthetic and a layout that emphasizes precision shooting. The artwork suggests a "pop star" or circus-style theme set inside a red tent, though the theme is considered somewhat abstract by players.

470431.overview:
The future just got sharper! This reboot delivers sleeker visuals, advanced tech, and intense robotic action that pushes the limits.

Robot 2018 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1985 solid-state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2018 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470662.overview:
Richie Rich is a fictional character in the Harvey Comics universe. He debuted in the comic book Little Dot #1, cover-dated September 1953, and was created by Alfred Harvey with artists Warren Kremer and Steve Muffatti. Beginning in 1980, Richie Rich appeared in his own Saturday morning cartoon, simply called Richie Rich. The show aired on The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show from 1980 to 1982 and The Pac-Man/Little Rascals/Richie Rich Show from 1982 to 1984.

This is a homebrew table for Visual Pinball 9 inspired by the cartoon version of the character.

470863.overview:
RetroFlair is a popular original pinball table for Future Pinball that celebrates classic gaming with a packed soundtrack of classic arcade and Amiga tunes. The table is something of a flagship release for Future Pinball and is automatically installed for users that set-up Future Pinball using BallerInstaller.

Originally created by the designer Rom between 2011 and 2013, it has since been extensively updated by TerryRed into a modern "BAM Edition" that showcases the high-end capabilities of the Future Pinball platform.

The modern BAM Edition transforms the original layout with advanced visuals and FizX physics. FizX uses techniques similar to nFozzy physics on VPX to completely change the physics for the flippers, slings, rubbers, targets, ball behavior and more that allows this table play much more realistically than anyone ever thought was possible on Future Pinball.

470899.overview:
Real is a rare cigarette-themed cocktail-style pinball machine released in May 1978 by Game Plan, Inc.. It belongs to a specific family of interchangeable cocktail tables (Model 110) that shared identical playfield layouts but featured different themed artwork.

The table features two flippers and a standard set of targets typical of early solid-state cocktail games. Unlike upright machines with a backbox, cocktail games like Real typically house their score displays beneath the playfield glass in the apron area, allowing players to see their score without looking away from the action.

Real was part of a production strategy where Game Plan sold a single base model with interchangeable playfields under various names, including Black Velvet, Rio, Camel Lights, Chuck-a-Luck, and Foxy Lady.

471067.overview:
The mining ship Red Dwarf has a reactor leak and the entire crew is killed by lethal radiation. Except for Dave Lister who was locked in Stasis at the time (punishment for bringing his pet Cat on board the ship).

When the radiation levels are safe, 3 million years later, the ship's computer (Holly) wakes Lister from his hypersleep. Holly creates a Hologram of Lister's roommate to keep him company. That hologram is Arnold Rimmer, the most annoying member of the ship's crew. Later, another humanoid is discovered on ship - a creature that had evolved over 3 million years from Lister's pet cat. The crew are then joined by Kryten - a robot which has been programmed to serve humanity.  Lister helps Kryten to break his programming and he becomes 'human'.

The Red Dwarf table for Future Pinball is an original virtual pinball table by SLAMT1LT based on the cult classic British sci-fi sitcom. It is widely praised for its humor, authentic sound clips, and immersive theme. The SMEG edition was released in 2010, and the ULTIMATE edition in 2014.

At some point during the game Queeg will assume control of the table and randomly operate the flippers.  Only blind luck and a direct hit with certain targets (any kickers) will stop Queeg's control.  Use nudge to direct the ball.

471123.overview:
The Ramones were an American punk rock band formed in the New York City neighborhood Forest Hills, Queens in 1974. Known for helping establish the punk movement in the United States and elsewhere, the Ramones are often recognized as one of the first bands of the genre.

This table was created by HauntFreaks in 2021 for Visual Pinball X. It's based on the Bally's Fireball from 1972 and features a disc spinner, zipper-flippers, multiball and music by the Ramones.

471229.overview:
Welcome to the Ready Player One pinball, where in the OASIS you can go anywhere, do anything, be anyone. It’s the year 2045 and your task as Parzival is to accomplish three challenges, which will reward you with the three keys.

Ready Player One is a digital table for Visual Pinball X based on the 2018 science fiction action movie of the same name. The game features scenes from the movie on the DMD, audio callouts and a soundtrack including Van Halen's "Jump".

471605.overview:
RoboCop: Dead or Alive Edition is an updated version of an original Future Pinball table based on the 1987 American science fiction action film, RoboCop. 

Created by prolific developer Rom in 2013, it later received a massive update by SLAMT1LT with his ULTIMATE Pro Edition, turning it into a new game. New gameplay, rules, sounds, voices, music, lighting effects, videos and more.

The Dead or Alive Edition was released by TerryRed in 2023. This version updates the ULTIMATE Pro Edition with modern physics, improved lighting, and enhanced audio-visual elements, featuring FizX 3.3 physics and PinEvent Lite features.

• FizX 3.3 Physics: Transforms the ball movement, flippers, slingshots, and targets to act and feel significantly more realistic, offering improved ball control over previous Future Pinball versions.
• PinEvent Lite: Integrates PinEvent features, allowing for basic DOFLinx (cabinet feedback), Pupil SSF (surround sound feedback), and Night Mode.
• Visual Overhaul: Includes new modernized lighting, shadows, ray-cast ball shadows, and updated art for plastics and the backbox.
• Gameplay Improvements: Added new fixes for gameplay progression and updated rules/codes, enhancing the overall experience.
• Sound Enhancement: Replaced older mechanical sounds with high-quality FLEEP sounds for a more authentic mechanical feel.
• BAM Integration: Built for BAM (Better Arcade Mode), utilizing advanced lighting and camera features.

471926.overview:
Road Girls Revisited is a popular original pinball table designed for the Future Pinball. Known as a fan-favorite, it is often featured in "must-have" table lists for the platform due to its engaging design and mature theme.

This Revisited version improved upon the original Road Girls design to enhance gameplay mechanics and table rules.

472160.overview: Marty02's Visual Pinball X mod of Data East's 1990 table makes a number of changes, including different artwork, slightly modified rules and lighting changes. It also has PUP pack compatibility for video support, and the option of using alt sound.

472187.overview:
Robots Invasion is a well-known digital table with a 1950s-inspired sci-fi theme. The narrative centers on a large-scale alien robot attack on major world cities, including London, Paris and New York.

The game was created by Polygame for Future Pinball, and as with his earlier table, DarkQuest (2008), it simulates the visual effects of a Williams Pinball 2000 table by displaying a "hologram" on the playfield.

The table is highly regarded for its cinematic atmosphere, and updated and enhanced versions have been released for Future Pinball by GeorgeH and by SLAMT1LT. Robots Invasion was converted to Visual Pinball X by UncleWilly in 2024.

479873.overview:
Based on the 1991 platform game for the Commodore Amiga, Robocod is a homebrew table from 2002 for an early version of Visual Pinball. Though the graphics and physics cannot really be compared with more modern digital tables, there is still some fun to be had for fans of the James Pond series, with the familiar music a particular highlight, and a clear set of mission objectives to achieve.

Light all 6 Penguins:
----------------------
 • Green Penguin: Hit ramp three times within 1 ball
 • Pink Penguin: 20 bumper hits
 • Red Penguin: Drop 5 targets within 1 ball
 • White Penguin: Hit 4 lanes within 1 ball
 • Blue Penguin: Hit either castle 3 times within 1 ball
 • Yellow Penguin: Hit Mystery Box 3 times when arrow Isn't flashing

Mystery Box:
-------------- 
 • Hit ramp to enable an award (yellow light flashes)
 • Hit mystery box (can be good or bad)

Loop:
------
 • Go for the loop, champ!

480512.overview:
Released for Visual Pinball X in 2021, this game is a mod of the JP Salas original table "AC/DC" (2012), incorporating the greatest hits of the long-running alternative rock band, the Red Hot Chili Peppers.

The game can be played with music videos via the included PuP pack, or with audio only.

480896.overview: A mod of Close Encounters of the Third Kind (Gottlieb, 1978) for Visual Pinball X, based on the rock band R.E.M. who were active from 1980 to 2011.

480951.overview:
Data East's King Kong table from 1990 was never actually released due to licensing issues, but a number of prototypes exist from different stages of development.

In 2012, Francisco666 and D-Struct released their fast-playing interpretation of these prototypes for Future Pinball, and this release was heavily modded in 2020 by RwL. The final result, released under the name "Return of King Kong" has much nicer visuals and better musical choices than any of Data East's original King Kong prototypes.

480965.overview:
John Rambo is doing hard time in jail when his former boss, Colonel Troutman, offers him a deal. If Rambo travels to Vietnam to try to find the American prisoners of war, his criminal record will be expunged. Rambo takes the reconnaissence assignment and agrees not to get involved in any of the action. However, when his Vietnamese lover, Co Bao, os killed by American forces, Rambo forgets his promise and takes matters into his own hands. Use your pinball skills to help Rambo defeat the enemy and free the POW's.

Released by Ivan TBA for Visual Pinball X in 2020, Rambo: First Blood Part II is based on the 1985 action film starring Sylvester Stallone, and is a mod of Raven (Gottlieb, 1986). Ivan TBA's table incorporates design elements from ArmyAviation's Rambo table for VPX, with new artwork, and additional sounds and music from the 1985 movie.

480971.overview: Balutito's mod of ArmyAviation's Rambo table for Visual Pinball X makes graphical changes to the table's apron, backglass, bumpers and flippers, slight changes to the playfield colours, and adds new sounds.

481078.overview: A tribute to the American rock group, the Red Hot Chili Peppers. This is an original table for Visual Pinball X created by Bigbeefr using the Orbital Framwork. A graphical mod by Balutito has also been released.

481079.overview: Balutito's Red Hot Chili Peppers table is a graphical mod of Bigbeefr's Red Hot Pinball for Visual Pinball X.

481131.overview: Balutito's table is a NSFW mod of The Walking Dead (Stern, 2014) for Visual Pinball X based on the comedy horror franchise that began with the 1985 movie The Return of the Living Dead.

481895.overview: Rocky: TKO Tribute is a re-theme of Ali (Stern, 1980) for Visual Pinball X. Two versions of the table exist: a regular version, released in 2021, and a Limited Edition with accompanying video PuP pack released in 2022.
